model: Integral ventilation units LWZ / LWA via ISG Modbus TCP/IP
equipment_type: Heat pump (integral ventilation unit, via ISG Modbus TCP gateway)
applies_to: Stiebel Eltron LWZ / LWA integral ventilation and heat pump units reached through an ISG web or ISG plus with the Modbus TCP/IP software extension.
summary: Stiebel Eltron's LWZ integral units combine ventilation with heat recovery, an exhaust-air heat pump and DHW. Over Modbus they are reached through the Internet Service Gateway (ISG) with the Modbus TCP/IP extension, which serves single 16-bit registers with fixed scaling per data type. The map covers system values (input registers 1-33), operating mode, heating/DHW/cooling setpoints and fan stages (holding 1001-1027), status flags (2001-2005), heat, energy and runtime counters (3001-3032) and the shared SG Ready registers.

addressing.note: The document states that ISG addressing is 1-based (its example: register 30501 is reached as address 501 with function code 04), so subtract one from the printed register number: outside temperature, printed 7, is requested at input register address 6. The document also warns that, depending on the configuration, an offset of 1 may have to be allowed for; confirm with outside temperature against the unit display.

source.title: Software documentation - Software extension for Internet Service Gateway - Modbus TCP/IP
source.pages: English section PDF pp. 35-39 (printed pp. 34-38): ventilation tables pp. 35-38, SG Ready and controller ID pp. 38-39; data types p. 26. German original PDF pp. 13-17 cross-checked.

notes: Stiebel Eltron does not host this software documentation publicly (its own download path returns 404). The linked copy is a retailer mirror of the unchanged Stiebel Eltron document with one shop cover page added in front.
Data types: type 2 = signed, value x 0.1; type 6 = unsigned, x 1; type 7 = signed, value x 0.01; type 8 = unsigned 0-255, x 1. Unavailable objects return 32768 (0x8000).
For LWZ units the controller reports -60 for a missing or open sensor lead and -50 for a shorted sensor lead.
Energy totals are split into a kWh register (0-999) and an MWh register: total = MWh x 1000 + kWh.

Rows marked '(x)' in the table apply only to the listed sub-models (LWZ 504, units with cooling, units with solar, LWZ 304/404/504/Trend); this is noted in the descriptions. Registers 18 and 19 (supply air fan) are listed for LWZ only, not LWA.

Left out: extract air temperature (23) and extract air dew point (24), because they are typed as signed x 0.1 values but given a 0-65535 range; BUS-STATUS (2003), typed unsigned but coded with negative values.
Holding registers 1016-1027 sit on a continuation page without a repeated table header in the English section; their values were checked against the German table.

SG Ready on/off (4001): the language tables of the same document disagree on the coding (German and Italian: 0 = off, 1 = on; English: 0 = on, 1 = off). No value labels are given here; test on site which code switches the function on.
WPM-managed heat pumps use another register set: see stiebel-eltron/isg-modbus-wpm-heat-pumps.

integration.summary: Poll the ISG on TCP port 502, unit ID 1. Read input registers (FC 04) for temperatures, fan speeds, status flags 2001 and fault status 2002; write holding registers (FC 06/16) for operating mode 1001, room/DHW setpoints and the ventilation stages 1018-1021. Subtract 1 from every printed register number.
integration.enable: The ISG web or ISG plus needs the Modbus TCP/IP software extension and, for the ISG web, the Basic service package. With an integral ventilation unit connected, check for it in SERVICEWELT under DIAGNOSIS > BUS SUBSCRIBER > ISG; if Modbus TCP/IP is not listed, update the ISG firmware or contact Stiebel Eltron service.
quirks: All points are 16-bit; totals use paired kWh/MWh registers.
Operating mode codes are not contiguous: 11 = automatic, 14 = manual.
Faults cannot be acknowledged over Modbus, only in SERVICEWELT.
The Modbus interface cannot run alongside other ISG software interfaces (read-only use with EMI excepted).
setup: Default ISG IP 192.168.0.126 on a direct PC link; DHCP behind a router. Change it on the Profile tab in SERVICEWELT.
gotchas: Do not run the ISG on the same CAN bus as a DCo-aktiv GSM module.
